notes.title: Achievement unlocked
notes.content:
Achievements have now been added to Dodo! See if you can unlock these 31 achievements as you travel through the Dodo galaxy...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762643/58793d4019493d0ca73c6c5b9f66ba4ce29d6f5b.png[/img]

Other updates include:

[list]
[*] You can now clear a word with CTRL+⌫ or ⌘+⌫
[*] Minor fix to moon 8A
[*] Minor fix to SFX volume slider
[/list]
